author: pi-agent

patch.value: Write the hash_algorithm field on history entries, matching pm CLI 2026.9.11 and later

pm CLI 2026.9.11 and later writes a top-level hash_algorithm: sha256 field on every history entry (named digest algorithms, pm-cli changelog pm-bbk8we). pm-rust's history entries omit this field: grep hash_algorithm src/history.rs returns no matches. Verified 2026-09-13 with pm CLI 2026.9.12 installed: the conformance_differential test (tests/conformance_differential.rs) fails on the first create operation because the published CLI emits hash_algorithm as the first field of each JSONL entry, and pm-rust does not. The record_hash also diverges because the hash input includes the hash_algorithm field. pm-rust reads a 2026.9.12 workspace correctly and history it writes passes 2026.9.12 pm health (ok true, 0 unreadable), so pm-rust relies on the legacy-default path where the hash algorithm is implied rather than named. This item tracks adding the hash_algorithm field to match pm CLI 2026.9.11+ output exactly, restoring byte-identical differential conformance.

Every history entry written by pm-rust includes a top-level hash_algorithm: sha256 field matching the field order and value pm CLI 2026.9.12 produces; the record_hash is computed over the same serialized bytes as the published CLI (including hash_algorithm); the conformance_differential test passes byte-for-byte against pm CLI 2026.9.12; strict Rust checks and the exact coverage gate pass

message: Created during tracker audit: the conformance_differential test fails against pm CLI 2026.9.12 because pm-rust omits the hash_algorithm field introduced in pm CLI 2026.9.11+.
